How to Use
Plug the hair dryer into a suitable power outlet
Select the desired heat and speed settings
Direct the airflow toward your hair while maintaining a suitable distance
Use the concentrator nozzle for focused and precise styling
Use the diffuser attachment to enhance natural curls and waves
Press the cool shot button to apply cool air and help set your hairstyle
Switch off and unplug the appliance after use

Maintenance & Care
Clean the removable air filter regularly to help maintain airflow
Remove accumulated dust and debris from the filter before use
Allow the appliance to cool before cleaning or storing
Store the hair dryer and attachments in a clean, dry place

Safety Information
Keep the hair dryer away from water and moisture
Do not use the appliance with wet hands
Do not block the air inlet or outlet during operation
Avoid directing hot air continuously at one area of the hair
Unplug the appliance after use
Allow the hair dryer to cool before storing
Stop using the appliance if it shows signs of damage or abnormal operation
